dedupe_keys.name: akep albania electronic communications statistical indicators quarterly and annual reports

description: The Albanian Electronic and Postal Communications Authority collects periodic data from authorised operators on standard forms and publishes the main indicators of the electronic communications market. Quarterly reports, most recently for the second quarter of 2026, and annual reports, such as those for 2024 and 2025, cover mobile telephony (active users, market shares and the split between contract and prepaid), fixed telephony (subscribers, market shares and subscribers with broadband), and internet access (fixed internet subscribers, mobile broadband subscribers on 3G and 4G, fixed broadband market shares by subscribers, and subscribers to bundled telephone, internet and TV services). A summary page also offers PDF charts of long series for each indicator. The authority also runs a speed test service at speedtest.akep.al. Coverage: Albania, national totals by quarter from at least 2023, with longer series in the charts. Format and access: PDF reports on the authority's website, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: PDF only, so figures must be transcribed; national totals with no regional split; operator-reported. Simulation uses: subscriber and technology mix baselines for Albanian telecom demand models. Related records: the ITU ICT statistics give comparable national series; the RATEL NetTest open data covers neighbouring Serbia.
